rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s commission-appointment letter: both appoint the recipient as chairman of a newly created scientific or technical advisory body, explain the body’s relationship to immediate defense needs and longer-range national objectives, enumerate its substantive remit, and authorize cooperation with government agencies and private experts. C01 and C24 use a similarly close commission-letter structure, but their policy-review and reporting missions are less closely aligned with the child’s continuing advisory and liaison function.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have therefore determined to establish a Science Advisory Committee of the Office of Defense Mobilization, to be available to the Defense Mobilization Director and to me
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this Commission within the Executive Office of the President is to study the broader and longer range aspects of the nation's materials problem as distinct from the immediate defense needs
shared_material.explanation: Both establish a presidential technical-policy body within the executive apparatus and distinguish its broader advisory mission from immediate defense operations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am therefore appointing you as Chairman
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am very pleased that you have agreed to serve as the Chairman of the President's Materials Policy Commission.
shared_material.explanation: The letters directly appoint or confirm the addressee as chairman of the new body.

shared_material.child_excerpt: To provide independent advice on scientific matters especially as regards the objectives and interrelations of the several Federal agencies... [and] advise concerning plans and methods
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The task of the Commission... will be to make an objective inquiry into all major aspects of the problem... and to make recommendations which will assist me in formulating a comprehensive policy
shared_material.explanation: Both define an objective, cross-agency technical advisory mandate intended to inform presidential policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am forwarding copies of this letter to the heads of the Government agencies... with the request that they extend you their full cooperation. Likewise, I expect that you will freely call on private scientific groups and individuals for assistance.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission will enjoy the cooperation of all agencies of Government whose functions and interests relate to your assignment. And of course you will want to solicit the cooperation of private industry.
shared_material.explanation: This is a concrete parallel administrative mechanism: government-wide cooperation supplemented by assistance from relevant private experts.
